name: Cloudgoat
description: Boeb's huge winged goat mount, in pain from unmilked udders.

description_citations.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving
description_citations.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving" by Tobi Ogundiran. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Boeb's cloudgoat arrives bleating, startling Flib, whose axe falls into Boeb's flesh and wakes him.
timeline.quote: to bury itself, just as Ygril had feared, firmly in Boeb's flesh.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving" by Tobi Ogundiran. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Boeb milks the cloudgoat into the bucket, nearly drowning Ygril, and then puts the bucket over the fire to boil.
timeline.quote: There came the unmistakable crackle of flames as Boeb settled the bucket over the furnace.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving

relations.quote: It was Boeb's mount, the only creature large enough for a giant to ride.
